{ "rules": [
    "When sentiment is strong positive (1.0), forecast prices are too low - increase by ~15-20% of sentiment multiplier",
    "When sentiment is negative (0.0), forecast prices are too high - decrease by sentiment value",
    "Model shows mean reversion to early forecast values - correct 3rd-5th day lag by moving toward current history",
    "Sentiment turning from negative to positive requires faster forecast recovery than model indicates",
    "When history prices are declining rapidly, model forecasts are too high - compress by 10-20% matching decline rate",
    "Sentiment persistence (same value 5+ days) indicates model hasn't incorporated the shift properly",
    "When true outcomes show more volatility than model, increase forecast variance by 20-30%"
] }
